title: Internal communication basics
summary: Use a calm, precise structure for internal updates, requests and handovers.
contentNotice: Demonstration learning content for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy, curriculum or language instruction and must be reviewed before operational use.

steps.title: State the point
steps.text: Open with the decision, request or material update.

steps.title: Add only useful context
steps.text: Include the facts another person needs to respond correctly.

steps.title: Make ownership visible
steps.text: If an action is required, state who is expected to do what and by when.

blocks.text: Politeness should not obscure the request. A composed MOSCATELLI message can still be explicit about ownership, timing and the decision needed.
